mapper.insert: insert into tbl_oauth (provider_id, provider, profile_url, member_id) values (#{providerId}, #{provider}, #{profileURL}, #{memberId})
mapper.select: select m.id, m.member_email, m.member_phone, m.member_password, m.member_name, m.member_alias, m.member_bio, m.member_status, m.member_login_verified, a.member_role, m.created_datetime, m.updated_datetime from tbl_member m join tbl_oauth o on m.id = o.member_id left join tbl_auth a on a.id = m.id where (m.member_email = #{loginId} or m.member_phone = #{loginId}) and m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' and o.provider = #{provider}

select m.id, m.member_email, m.member_phone, m.member_password, m.member_name, m.member_alias, m.member_bio, m.member_status, m.member_login_verified, a.member_role, m.created_datetime, m.updated_datetime from tbl_member m join tbl_oauth o on m.id = o.member_id left join tbl_auth a on a.id = m.id where o.provider = #{provider} and o.provider_id = #{providerId}
